title: What happened in AI — Jul 30, 2026
intro: Agent infrastructure got more operational today: LangChain shipped governance controls into its LLM Gateway, Google says GKE's agent sandbox cuts cost per agent by 75%, and a wave of new local tools launched to audit what coding agents actually do.

China's open-weight ecosystem kept compounding — DeepSeek is building a new Inner Mongolia data center, Moonshot is targeting a $50B IPO valuation after open-sourcing its MoonEP training library, and Kimi K3's free tier keeps pulling US users toward Chinese models.
highlights: LangChain shipped LangSmith LLM Gateway, baking spend limits, PII redaction, and trace continuity into agent runtime governance.
A cluster of new HN tools launched to introspect coding agents: Collie (browser/desktop/code harness), Tuneloop (transcript analyzer), and Wasted Cycles (wall-clock profiler).
Google says GKE's agent sandbox cuts cost per agent by 75%; AWS published a SageMaker meta-monitoring pattern for production inference oversight.
OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 pricing on its Luna and Terra variants, pitching efficiency as the lever for running agentic workflows at scale.
Moonshot AI is targeting a $50B IPO valuation, open-sourced its MoonEP expert-parallelism library, and Kimi K3's free availability keeps drawing US users.

categories.name: Agent Orchestration & Governance
categories.summary: Agent infrastructure providers shipped concrete operational controls today: spend limits and PII redaction at the gateway layer, a 75% cost cut for GKE-hosted agents, and orchestration extending into multi-robot and ontology-backed systems.

articles.title: LangSmith LLM Gateway: runtime governance built into the agent lifecycle
articles.summary: Adds spend limits, PII redaction, and trace continuity directly into the agent runtime layer, giving platform teams built-in cost and compliance guardrails instead of bolted-on infra.

articles.title: Do more with less: How GKE can reduce your cost per agent by 75%
articles.summary: Google says its new GKE Agent Sandbox pattern cuts cost per agent by 75%, its answer to running large fleets of autonomous agents economically.

articles.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
articles.summary: DeepMind's ER 2 model adds video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration, extending Gemini Robotics beyond single-robot control into coordinated fleets.

articles.title: Ontologies Are So Back: Why AI Agents Are Reviving the Semantic Web
articles.summary: Argues platform teams are reviving formal ontologies to keep probabilistic agents inside deterministic boundaries — semantic structure as a hallucination guardrail, not academic curiosity.

categories.name: Coding Agent Tooling & Developer Workflow
categories.summary: A cluster of new indie tools launched to observe and audit coding agents rather than just run them, alongside GitHub Copilot's own workflow upgrade.

articles.title: Show HN: Collie – a local AI harness that runs the browser, desktop and code
articles.summary: A local harness that runs the browser, desktop, and code together, giving a coding agent one control surface instead of stitching separate tools.

articles.title: Stacked sessions and pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
articles.summary: GitHub Copilot's app now supports stacked sessions and PRs, letting a modernization effort split into a queued chain of dependent agent sessions instead of one long-running task.

articles.title: Show HN: Tuneloop – a local CLI for analyzing coding agent session transcripts
articles.summary: A local CLI that parses coding-agent session transcripts, aiming to expose the decision sequence behind what an agent actually shipped.

articles.title: Show HN: Wasted Cycles – Local wall-clock profiler for AI coding agents
articles.summary: A local wall-clock profiler for AI coding agents, built to surface where an agent's session time is actually going.

articles.title: Show HN: a Rust coding agent that is compatible with Claude Code plugins/skills
articles.summary: A 14MB Rust coding agent compatible with Claude Code's plugin and skills format, adding a lightweight alternative runtime for the same extension ecosystem.

categories.name: AI Infrastructure, Inference & Deployment
categories.summary: Cloud providers and OpenAI pushed on the operational and cost side of running models in production.

articles.title: Inference meta-monitoring for Amazon SageMaker AI endpoints with Amazon Quick
articles.summary: AWS outlines a meta-monitoring layer for SageMaker AI endpoints built on Amazon Quick, tracking prediction and data drift above the inference pipeline itself.

articles.title: Deploying Kimi K3 on AWS
articles.summary: AWS published a deployment guide for Moonshot's open-weight Kimi K3, its own signal that enterprises are running Chinese open models on US cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
articles.summary: OpenAI cut pricing on GPT-5.6's Luna and Terra variants, pitching efficiency gains as the lever for enterprises to run agentic workflows at scale.

categories.name: China's Open-Weight AI Push
categories.summary: Chinese labs advanced on three fronts at once today — capital, infrastructure, and open-source tooling — while their free open-weight models keep pulling US users.

articles.title: DeepSeek is developing a massive AI data centre in Inner Mongolia - AFR
articles.summary: DeepSeek is building a large AI data center in Inner Mongolia, expanding its own compute base rather than relying solely on hyperscaler capacity.

articles.title: Moonshot AI targets USD 50 billion valuation ahead of Hong Kong IPO - KrASIA
articles.summary: Moonshot AI is targeting a $50 billion valuation ahead of a Hong Kong IPO, a sharp jump from its prior funding round.

articles.title: With Moonshot's free Kimi K3, China changes the sovereign AI playbook - restofworld.org
articles.summary: Moonshot's decision to give away Kimi K3 for free is reshaping the sovereign-AI playbook, trading licensing revenue for adoption and geopolitical reach.

articles.title: Moonshot AI Open-Sources MoonEP: A Perfectly Balanced Expert Parallelism Library for MoE Training - MarkTechPost
articles.summary: Moonshot open-sourced MoonEP, an expert-parallelism library it built for training its own MoE models, handing other labs its infrastructure for scaling mixture-of-experts training.

articles.title: Chinese AI models gain US users with lower costs and open weights - Memeburn
articles.summary: Lower costs and open weights are pulling US users toward Chinese AI models, a pattern that keeps pressuring the pricing power of closed US frontier labs.
